div.head: Cn 1018 12
div.ab: 7 we lærað 7 we biddað. 7 on godes naman beodað. þæt ænig cristen man binnon six manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne wifige. ne on his mæges lafe. þe swa neahsib wære.
And we lærað and we biddað and on Godes naman beodað þæt ænig Cristen man binnon six manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne wifige, ne on his mæges lafe þe swa neahsib wære,

And we teach and we command and in the name of God enjoin that no Christian man ever take a wife from his own kindred within six degrees of relationship, nor the widow of his kinsman, who was as closely related to him.
And we instruct, pray, and decree in God’s name that no Christian man shall ever take a wife within six degrees of kinship in his own family, nor the widow of one so closely related,
